title: Push notifications
description: Expo push notifications with self-only send callable, FCM helper for native tokens, permission flow, device registration and deep-link friendly tap handling.
notes: Remote push requires a development build — Expo Go dropped remote notification support on Android.
sendPushToUser only notifies the authenticated caller (tighten further for admin broadcast callables).
Non-Expo tokens are sent via Admin FCM (see functions/src/lib/fcm.ts).
Notification taps emit appEvents.DeepLink when a deeplink/url is present.
